stem:
Kavya points the tiny hole of a pinhole camera at a lamp and looks at the tracing-paper screen at the back.

What appears on the screen?

options.text: an upside-down image of the lamp, reversed left to right
an upright image of the lamp, reversed left to right
a bright patch with the same shape as the hole
an upside-down image of the lamp even when the pinhole faces away from the lamp

teacher.key_rationale: Rays through a pinhole cross, so the screen image is upside down and left-right reversed. Upright-but-reversed conflates mechanisms. Matching the hole shape captures a surface feature. Facing away omits the need for light from the lamp.
